label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 62
title: MVP: tier/model capability-fit view (per-agent required vs supported, at-risk/incompatible callouts)
body:
Dashboard view for the tier/model fit: for the selected tier, show per agent the chosen model and whether it meets the agent's requirements (OK / AT_RISK / INCOMPATIBLE), with callouts and one-click substitutions within the tier; surface the live capability-probe results. Pairs with BI-0031 (BYOT/model registry) and the tier page. Depends on backend BI-0076.

OWNER E2E WORKFLOW (dashboard):
1) Tier page -> a 'Check model compatibility' BUTTON runs the preflight and shows the report (OK / AT_RISK / INCOMPATIBLE) with the recommended action.
2) Per-AGENT drill-down: from the E2E pipeline view or the Agents page, click an agent to see its model, compatibility status and recommendation for that agent.
3) Per-MODEL view: click a model to see which agents use it, its probe result and substitution suggestions (same tier only).
4) Apply: 'Apply recommendation' (auto default after timeout) or 'Keep as-is'; the applied substitutions are shown and persisted (model-fit.json).
5) Surface the fit report/last-checked time on the tier card; block/warn when an agent is INCOMPATIBLE.
Depends on backend BI-0077 (model-fit API).
